import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
import re
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Map authors to integers for target encoding (Order: EAP, HPL, MWS)
author_to_label = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
label_to_author = {0: "EAP", 1: "HPL", 2: "MWS"}

# Add label column to train_df
train_df["label"] = train_df["author"].map(author_to_label)
test_df["label"] = -1


def preprocess_text(text):
    """Add vocabulary diversity and punctuation type distribution features"""
    text = str(text).lower()

    # Basic text statistics
    text_len = len(text)
    word_count = len(text.split())
    char_count = len(text)

    # Character-level statistics
    punct_count = len(re.findall(r"[.,!?;:\-]", text))
    avg_word_len = word_count > 0 and np.mean([len(w) for w in text.split()])

    # Punctuation type distribution
    semicolons = len(re.findall(r";", text))
    colons = len(re.findall(r":", text))
    exclamation = len(re.findall(r"!", text))
    question = len(re.findall(r"\?", text))

    # Punctuation ratios
    if punct_count > 0:
        semicolon_ratio = semicolons / punct_count
        colon_ratio = colons / punct_count
        exclamation_ratio = exclamation / punct_count
        question_ratio = question / punct_count
    else:
        semicolon_ratio = 0.0
        colon_ratio = 0.0
        exclamation_ratio = 0.0
        question_ratio = 0.0

    # Vocabulary diversity features
    unique_words = len(set(text.split()))
    type_token_ratio = word_count > 0 and unique_words / word_count
    vocabulary_entropy = unique_words > 0 and np.log(unique_words + 1) / np.log(
        max(word_count, 1) + 1
    )

    return {
        "text_len": text_len,
        "word_count": word_count,
        "char_count": char_count,
        "punct_count": punct_count,
        "avg_word_len": avg_word_len,
        "semicolon_ratio": semicolon_ratio,
        "colon_ratio": colon_ratio,
        "exclamation_ratio": exclamation_ratio,
        "question_ratio": question_ratio,
        "unique_word_count": unique_words,
        "type_token_ratio": type_token_ratio,
        "vocabulary_entropy": vocabulary_entropy,
    }


train_preprocessed = train_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_preprocessed = test_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)

train_stats = pd.DataFrame(train_preprocessed.tolist(), index=train_df.index)
test_stats = pd.DataFrame(test_preprocessed.tolist(), index=test_df.index)

train_df = pd.concat([train_df, train_stats], axis=1)
test_df = pd.concat([test_df, test_stats], axis=1)

train_val, temp = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["label"]
)
train_fold = train_val
val_fold = temp

# Word n-gram TF-IDF vectorizer
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_df=0.95, min_df=2, max_features=50000
)

# Character n-gram TF-IDF vectorizer - IMPROVEMENT: 2-4 instead of 3-5
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4), max_df=0.95, min_df=2, max_features=50000
)

X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_fold["text"])
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_fold["text"])

X_train_stats = train_fold[
    [
        "text_len",
        "word_count",
        "char_count",
        "punct_count",
        "avg_word_len",
        "semicolon_ratio",
        "colon_ratio",
        "exclamation_ratio",
        "question_ratio",
        "unique_word_count",
        "type_token_ratio",
        "vocabulary_entropy",
    ]
].values
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray(), X_train_stats])
y_train = train_fold["label"]

X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(val_fold["text"])
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(val_fold["text"])
X_val_stats = val_fold[
    [
        "text_len",
        "word_count",
        "char_count",
        "punct_count",
        "avg_word_len",
        "semicolon_ratio",
        "colon_ratio",
        "exclamation_ratio",
        "question_ratio",
        "unique_word_count",
        "type_token_ratio",
        "vocabulary_entropy",
    ]
].values
X_val = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray(), X_val_stats])
y_val = val_fold["label"]

# Train Multinomial Naive Bayes
model = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Calculate validation multi-class log loss
model_classes = list(model.classes_)
probabilities = model.predict_proba(X_val)
y_val_mapped = np.array(y_val)
val_loss = log_loss(y_val_mapped, probabilities)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_loss:.6f}")

# Retrain on full training set for final submission
X_full_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_full_train_char = char_vectorizer.transform(train_df["text"])
X_full_train_stats = train_df[
    [
        "text_len",
        "word_count",
        "char_count",
        "punct_count",
        "avg_word_len",
        "semicolon_ratio",
        "colon_ratio",
        "exclamation_ratio",
        "question_ratio",
        "unique_word_count",
        "type_token_ratio",
        "vocabulary_entropy",
    ]
].values
X_full_train = np.hstack(
    [X_full_train_word.toarray(), X_full_train_char.toarray(), X_full_train_stats]
)
y_full_train = train_df["label"]

model_final = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1)
model_final.fit(X_full_train, y_full_train)

# Predict on test set
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
X_test_stats = test_df[
    [
        "text_len",
        "word_count",
        "char_count",
        "punct_count",
        "avg_word_len",
        "semicolon_ratio",
        "colon_ratio",
        "exclamation_ratio",
        "question_ratio",
        "unique_word_count",
        "type_token_ratio",
        "vocabulary_entropy",
    ]
].values
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray(), X_test_stats])
test_predictions = model_final.predict_proba(X_test)

final_classes = list(model_final.classes_)
class_col_map = {label_to_author[idx]: idx for idx, label in enumerate(final_classes)}
print(f"Class to column mapping: {class_col_map}")

submission_columns = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

sub_proba = []
for col in submission_columns:
    if col in class_col_map:
        idx = class_col_map[col]
        prob_col = test_predictions[:, idx]
    else:
        idx = final_classes.index(col)
        prob_col = test_predictions[:, idx]
    sub_proba.append(prob_col)

sub_ids = test_df["id"]
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"id": sub_ids, "EAP": sub_proba[0], "HPL": sub_proba[1], "MWS": sub_proba[2]}
)

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"\nFinal Validation Log Loss: {val_loss:.6f}")
